snippet.title: Dumb Ways Jr Loopy's Train Set
snippet.description:
Before the Dumb Ways characters grew up, they were already making mischief in all sorts of places – kitchens, planes, and of course, trains!

▷ Subscribe Us at Awesome App for Kids: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCT7mMNGujNvbS0kDzIZhTAw

Dumb Ways Jr Loopy's Train Set:
► iOS: https://itunes.apple.com/au/app/dumb-ways-jr-loopys-train-set/id1087693459?mt=8

► Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=au.com.metro.dwjr.loopys&hl=en

Price: USD2.99

Take Loopy and his friends on a train trip! Pick them up and drop them off at different stations. Build your own train track and add fun items to the scene. Pull the handle to hear the train whistle. Toot, toot - let’s go! 

Loopy’s Train Set draws on the inherent fun of train sets, engaging children in open-ended play and problem solving. The app has been carefully designed to foster children’s sense of creativity and fun. Your child is sure to enjoy the journey! 

Features: 
• Two modes of play: Drive and Build
• Three levels of play in each mode
• Pre-set tracks to drive on
• Different-shaped track pieces to build with
• Surprises to discover and add to each scene
• Perfect for 3-7 year olds
• Engaging characters support children’s pretend play and story-telling
• No in-app purchases
• Play without wifi or internet
